title: The Rural road behind the farm
subtitle: 社区社会 · 主题语境阅读
theme: 社区社会（社会服务与人际沟通·社区与社会参与）
meta: 主题语境：社区社会（社会服务与人际沟通·社区与社会参与）　|　核心词汇：rural　|　正文 344 words　|　高三一轮复习
intro: 请阅读文章，根据上下文判断每一处 rural 的用法与含义，再完成 Task 1—Task 3。
passage: In 1950 the writer wrote of ① a rural road behind the farm in the manuscript, and everybody in the study said at once that it was ② so rural that nobody in the study would go near it. Three months on, people still spoke of that morning, and of how the writer, who never explained anything, had done it year after year and gone home; it was the rural ones, my mother said, that people remembered longest.

It was ③ the rural road behind the farm that anybody there had ever seen, or so the manuscript for January 1944 claims. My mother, who had seen them all, thought it ④ too rural to be of any use to anybody, and said as much to the reader who had come to help; the rural ones, she used to say, were never the useful ones.

My uncle, who kept the page at the far shelf, meant something else entirely. He called the whole business ⑤ a rural life of the county, and said that no reader in his right mind would call it ⑥ as rural as the life of the county they had once had in the old study. He was never a man who cared whether a thing was rural or not, and he said so.

By 1957 the matter had shrunk to half a line in the manuscript. What the line asked for was ⑦ something rural, and nothing besides. The reader from the next study called the whole plan ⑧ quite rural; everybody laughed, and then did exactly what he had said. After that the manuscript kept the names of the rural ones only.

My mother said nothing at all. In 1960, for the whole place, she wrote of another rural road behind the farm in the same manuscript, and the work, which took two months, seemed ⑨ no less rural than anybody had expected. ⑩ The rural life of the county that nobody had wanted to name, she said in 1962, was the one she could never quite name; the rural ones, she added, are always the ones that stay.

task1.title: Task 1　语境辨义
task1.intro: 请为文中十处画线形式选择对应的用法说明。
options: A. adj. 乡村（前置定语 a rural road behind the farm：1950 年写作者在手稿里记下的那件乡村的路）
B. adj. 乡村／田园（两处加强说法：so rural that … 与 no less rural than …）
C. adj. 乡村／田园（两处定语从句式的最高级说法，见第 3、10 题）
D. adj. 乡村（表语 too rural to do：母亲觉得它太乡村，反倒派不上用场）
E. adj. 田园（前置定语 a rural life of the county：叔叔把整件事称作一桩田园的乡村生活）
F. adj. 田园（同级比较 as rural as：拿眼前这桩跟旧日那桩县里的乡村生活相比）
G. adj. 田园（后置定语 something rural：修饰不定代词时须放在其后）
H. adj. 田园（受程度副词修饰 quite rural：那位读者的评价）

items.q: a rural road behind the farm
the rural road behind the farm that
a rural life of the county
The rural life of the county that

answers.why: rural 意为“乡村”，1950 年写作者在手稿里记下的是“一件乡村的路”，此处作前置定语 a rural road behind the farm。
rural 意为“乡村”，此处用 so rural that 结构，说它乡村到书斋里没人敢靠近。
rural 意为“乡村”，手稿上 一月 那行字说那是当地人从未见过的乡村农场后面乡间的路，等于最高级的说法。
rural 意为“乡村”，母亲认为这件东西“太乡村了，谁也用不上”，too rural to do 表示“太……以致不能”。
rural 意为“田园”，叔叔把整件事称作“一桩田园的乡村生活”，此处作前置定语 a rural life of the county。
rural 意为“田园”，叔叔不肯说它“跟旧日那桩县里的乡村生活一样田园”，同级比较用 as rural as。
rural 意为“田园”，手稿上那半行字要的是“田园的东西”，something 被形容词修饰时形容词须后置：something rural。
rural 意为“田园”，邻书斋来的那位读者认为这套计划“相当田园”，quite 修饰原级 rural。
rural 意为“田园”，no less rural than 表示“其田园不亚于……”，此处说这趟活儿之田园不亚于任何人的预料。
rural 意为“田园”，母亲 1962 年说的是“那桩她始终叫不出名字的田园乡村生活”，that 从句限定到极致。

task2.title: Task 2　语境运用
task2.intro: 请把下列句子译成英文，括号里是必须用到的形式。
items: 1950 年，写作者在手稿里记下了一件乡村的路。（a rural road behind the farm）
它乡村到书斋里没有一个人敢靠近。（so rural that …）
母亲觉得它太乡村，谁也用不上。（too rural to …）
叔叔把整件事称作一桩田园的乡村生活。（a rural life of the county）
他说，谁也不会认为它跟旧日那桩县里的乡村生活一样田园。（as rural as …）
到了 1957 年，手稿上只剩半行字：要的是一件田园的东西。（something rural）
answers: In 1950 the writer wrote of a rural road behind the farm in the manuscript.
It was so rural that nobody in the study would go near it.
My mother thought it too rural to be of any use to anybody.
My uncle called the whole business a rural life of the county.
He said nobody would call it as rural as the life of the county they had once had.
By 1957 the manuscript asked for nothing but something rural.

task3.title: Task 3　语境写作
task3.intro: 请写 5—6 个句子，至少使用 rural 的 3 种不同用法（前置定语、表语、比较级／最高级、后置定语等）；至少使用下列词语中的 3 个。
answers: In 1950 the writer wrote of a rural road behind the farm in the manuscript, and nobody forgot it.
It was the rural road behind the farm that anybody there had ever seen, or so the manuscript says.
My mother thought it too rural to be of any use, and said so plainly.
My uncle called the whole business a rural life of the county, and nobody argued with him.
The reader from the next study called the plan quite rural, and everybody laughed.
The rural ones, my mother said, are always the ones that stay.
